act.name: Delhi Rent Control Act, 1958
act.description: State Act governing rent control, eviction protection, and tenancy in National Capital Territory of Delhi.

sections.title: Protection of Tenant Against Eviction in Delhi
sections.chapter: Chapter III - Control of Eviction of Tenants
sections.text:
(1) Notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained in any other law or contract, no order or decree for the recovery of possession of any premises shall be made by any court or Controller in favour of the landlord against a tenant:
Provided that the Controller may, on an application made to him in the prescribed manner, make an order for the recovery of the possession of the premises on one or more specified grounds, such as non-payment of rent despite notice.
sections.plain_language_summary: In Delhi, landlords cannot evict tenants without obtaining an order from the Rent Controller after serving written notice.
